facts.fact: Libya Observer reports that the Minister of Labour and Rehabilitation, meeting Al-Nasr Information Technology, was told the ministry's integrated digital platform, supported by AI technologies and linking its departments, was about 30% complete, with standards and the system framework finished.

systems.system: Integrated digital platform, Ministry of Labour and Rehabilitation
systems.owner: Ministry of Labour and Rehabilitation with Al-Nasr Information Technology

LBY.note: The platform links ministry departments and no sector tool giving a diagnosis, score or decision is described.
No AI model, dataset or computing built or hosted in the country is stated.
